# International University of Monaco (IUM)

> > International University of Monaco (IUM) offers Bachelor, MSc, MBA, and DBA programs in business, finance, luxury management, and entrepreneurship with a focus on career development and Monaco's unique business ecosystem.

IUM is part of OMNES Education and provides internationally-accredited business education in Monaco, featuring specialized programs in luxury management, finance, and yachting industries. The university emphasizes practical career preparation through networking events, industry partnerships, and alumni engagement.

## Key Topics

- MBA programs
- MSc Finance
- Bachelor programs
- Luxury Management
- Career Development

## Academic Programs & Admissions

- [How is the Bachelor's program structured?](https://www.monaco.edu/en/faq-all-the-answers-to-your-questions-3/how-is-the-bachelors-program-structured): Bachelor program structure, specializations, and admission requirements
- [Qu'est-ce qu'un MSc en Finance ? Définition, programme, débouchés](https://www.monaco.edu/quest-ce-quun-msc-en-finance-definition-programme-debouches): MSc Finance program definition, curriculum, and career opportunities
- [Comment bien choisir son MBA ?](https://www.monaco.edu/pourquoi-faire-un-mba-2-2-2): Guide to choosing the right MBA program with AMBA accreditation criteria
- [Certificazioni Online](https://www.monaco.edu/it/certificazioni-online): IUM online certifications for executive education and professional development
- [Open Day on Campus](https://www.monaco.edu/en/open-day-on-campus): IUM campus open day for Bachelor, MSc, MBA, and DBA program presentations
